Need parse every BC story. Most are standard "As a role, I want to ... so that ..." Maybe some malformed. Need identify if role missing or functionality missing. Let's list all 69 and evaluate.

Criterion: Well-formed syntactic individual; includes at least role and means (expected functionality). Operational: Violation when either stakeholder role or requested functionality cannot be identified from core story text.

Need judge from own text.

Let's enumerate with possible issues.

BC-002: "As a anonymoususer, I want to view a list of user profiles, so that I know who is attending the conference." role and means. No.

BC-004: "As a attendee, I want to have a very clear map where the buildings and rooms are, so that I can make it to class on time." role attendee, means have map. No.

BC-005: "As a trainer, I want to edit my training node myself, so that the training coordinators don't have to and links to slides." Role trainer, means edit training node, possibly second means "links to slides" but at least one. No.

BC-006: "As a trainee, I want to limit to one registration per day per authenticated user, so that we don't have duplicate spaces." role trainee, means limit to one registration per day per authenticated user. No.
